mapper.sql: n.important, n.pinned, n.audience::text AS audience, n.status, n.version, n.first_published_at, n.published_at, n.edited_at, n.archived_at, cu.display_name AS created_by_display_name, uu.display_name AS updated_by_display_name, n.updated_at FROM notices n JOIN users cu ON cu.id = n.created_by JOIN users uu ON uu.id = n.updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT n.body, WHERE n.space_id = #{spaceId} AND n.event_id = #{eventId} AND n.id = #{id}
SELECT left(n.body, #{headLength}) AS body, WHERE n.space_id = #{spaceId} AND n.event_id = #{eventId} AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT id FROM notices WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND pinned ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT o.user_id FROM event_users o WHERE o.space_id = #{spaceId} AND o.event_id = #{eventId} AND ( NOT OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_user_permissions p WHERE p.space_id = o.space_id AND p.event_id = o.event_id AND p.user_id = o.user_id AND p.permission = 'EVENT_READ' AND p.effect = 'GRANT')) ORDER BY o.user_id
